fullContentHtml:
RBI Assistant 2025 Marks / Score Card & Cut Off - Complete Details

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has officially released the Score Card, Marks and Category-wise Cut Off for the post of Assistant Examination 2025. Candidates who appeared in the examination can check their section-wise marks by logging in with their Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Start Date : September 2025
  • Prelims Exam Date : November 2025
  • Mains Exam Date : December 2025
  • Scorecard & Marks Released : 19 September 2026

Important Links

  • Check RBI Assistant Score Card / Marks
  • Download Cut Off Marks Notice PDF
  • RBI Official Website
